units: <cite ref="Megillah 22b:11">Meg. 22ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 26:1">Lev. XXVI, 1</cite> <he>אבן משכית</he>) <he>לא אסרה תורה אלא ר׳ של וכ׳</he> the Torah forbids only prostration on a stone pavement (in a synagogue).

<cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 6:2">Shek. VI, 2</cite>; Y. ib. 49ᶜ a priest was splitting wood in the wood cell of the Temple <he>וראה את הר׳ וכ׳</he> and noticed that the pavement there was different from the others. Y. Naz.
